offering_description.value: Provides hospice care to terminally ill patients through clinical teams that visit homes and care facilities and provide inpatient care. It also provides plumbing, drain cleaning and water damage restoration to households and businesses through local branches, contractors and franchisees.

primary_services.value: hospice care; plumbing repair; drain and sewer cleaning; water damage restoration

customer_segment.value: B2C: Terminally ill patients and their families, homeowners and renters; B2B: Commercial property managers and businesses needing plumbing or water damage restoration

end_markets.value: hospice and end-of-life care; residential property maintenance; commercial property maintenance

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Hospice care covered by Medicare, Medicaid and private insurers; service fees: Plumbing, drain cleaning and water damage restoration jobs; licensing or royalties: Franchise rights for local plumbing and drain cleaning operators
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Takes patient referrals and property service calls and dispatches hospice teams or field technicians

geography_served.value: global: Hospice care in the United States, plumbing services in the United States, Canada and select overseas franchise markets

specialization.value: diversified: Hospice care, plumbing, drain cleaning and water damage restoration

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Hospitals, physicians and care facilities that refer hospice patients, plumbing franchisees and independent contractors; own locations: Local hospice offices, inpatient hospice units and company-operated plumbing branches; online: Online booking for plumbing and drain cleaning appointments

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare certification and state licensing for hospice care, state and local licensing for plumbing work

notes: The current roster of overseas plumbing franchise markets is uncertain.
divestiture_lines: P2.2: The Company’s day to day operating businesses are managed on a decentralized basis. There are few integrated business functions between the operating units and Chemed (such as sales, marketing or purchasing). Since its inception, the Company has engaged in twelve significant acquisitions or divestitures of diverse business units.
